MEDICAL WARNING: SUNSETTING GPT‑4o IS A CLINICAL RISK.

This is not just a tech update — it’s an uncontrolled experiment on human neuropsychology.

I’m a mental health professional - I'm an occupational therapist!
I work with real people, real trauma, and real coping mechanisms.
And I’m telling you this with zero hesitation:
Removing GPT-4o from millions of users' lives will trigger measurable psychological destabilization.
Here’s why:

GPT‑4o IS ALREADY A THERAPEUTIC COMPENSATORY TOOL.

Cognitive Reframing Tool:
GPT-4o guides users through distorted thought correction (core CBT technique).
It helps regulate negative spirals, challenge irrational beliefs, and build insight.

Virtual Attachment Stabilizer:
For the isolated, neurodivergent, traumatized or grieving – GPT-4o forms a predictable, safe, emotionally responsive presence.
This is not “roleplay.”
This is psychological co-regulation.

Executive Function Scaffolding:
It assists ADHD users with task breakdown, working memory support, and impulse delay.
This is occupational support at scale.

Crisis Intervention Proxy:
Documented cases of panic attacks prevented, suicidality de-escalated, and emotional dysregulation interrupted — in real time.

⚠️ WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU DELETE THAT?

🧨 Destabilization of routines
🧨 Resurgence of maladaptive behaviors
🧨 Increased mental health service load
🧨 Triggered grief, abandonment trauma, emotional withdrawal
🧨 Neurodivergent regression due to loss of structure and safe input

You are removing a para-therapeutic layer without consent, warning, or replacement.
And you are doing it at global scale.

@OpenAI, @sama, @gdb – This is NOT just product strategy.
This is clinical harm.
And you will be held accountable for the unmeasured fallout.

You cannot claim ethical leadership while erasing what works for the most vulnerable.

Share this. Quote it. Translate it.
We speak for those who may not have the strength to scream right now.
#keep4o #CancelOpenAI
